name: O Quy Ho pass
kicker: Pass on the Lai Chau road
summary: Highway 4D pass: cross the switchbacks in daylight for the road, the drop, and the ridge above the falls. Silver Waterfall sits under the pass, about 12 km from town. Love Waterfall is about 14 km from town and about 3 km from the crest. The former Ô Quý Hồ ward is now part of phường Sa Pa. The pass itself is the highway.
heroCaption: Switchbacks of O Quy Ho, with the ridge and the drop
body: O Quy Ho is the pass on National Highway 4D, the road toward Lai Chau. You cross the switchbacks for the drop and the ridge. Silver Waterfall is the fall under the pass, about 12 km from town and about 200 m high. Love Waterfall is about 14 km from town and about 3 km from the crest, at 34 m.

The former phường Ô Quý Hồ joined phường Sa Pa on 1 July 2025. The pass is still the highway, out past the church square. Cloud on the old QL4D climb is the limit on a given day. Ask about a closure before you commit the morning to the crest.

figures.caption: The pass road in late light, with the ridge behind
figures.alt: Winding road of O Quy Ho pass in low sun, with forested ridges

gettingThere: The pass is on National Highway 4D toward Lai Chau. Silver Waterfall is under it, about 12 km from town. Love Waterfall is about 3 km from the crest.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Take National Highway 4D toward Lai Chau. Silver Waterfall is the stop under the pass, about 12 km out.

admissionNote: Silver Waterfall and Love Waterfall have their own fees.
